## Orientation

Work only in /home/andrewyin/se-workflow--verify-budget. This is the verification task. Run the phase checks and do not edit the tree. If a command fails, return fail and stop. Do not call adaptive-artifacts to write. The store-read command below is allowed because it only lists and gets records. Do not run the full suite. No other executor is editing these files.

R1: A verification task runs that phase's integration check through the real entry point, and the tests that phase's exit criteria name.

R2: A verification verify_command does not run the whole tests tree. It does not run tests/test_dashboard_app.py or another pre-existing pilot file unless a -k filter limits it to the tests this phase added.

R3: Closing a task runs that task's verify_command. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md do not tell the agent to run the full suite before close.

R4: When a verification check fails, the executor returns fail and does not edit the tree. The work-item stays in_progress. The assessment for that requirement uses next execute.

R5: Planned verification tasks verify-spec-view, verify-evidence-matrix, and verify-journal-view no longer carry a full-suite acceptance when they dispatch.

Invariants: The phase still has one verification task that depends on the other work-items. One acceptance is still an integration check through the real entry point. A failed check caused by the task's code still uses assessment next execute. The parent session remains the only store writer.

Assumptions: Phase-scoped commands are short enough that the verification task finishes within 10 minutes, including executor time, because the executor no longer edits the tree. Regressions outside the named tests are outside this loop.

phase-checks-only: Verification runs the phase integration check and the tests that phase names. Task close does not add the full suite.

verify-stop: A failing verification check is recorded and routed to execute. The verification task does not edit the tree.
